game_concept: A adventure race set in Sand Dunes – Camel Trail, a camel trail: the oasis keeper must handle scarab swarms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Pseudocode Bridge: Convert plain-language pseudocode into working code steps to cross the gap.
theme: Sand Dunes – Camel Trail: a camel trail
core_gameplay_loop: Solve the CP1 stations in the shared Canvas shell while the Week 4 game theme awaits course approval.
player_objective: Archive variation 1: classify and verify C history, characteristics and language categories for History/classification review.
controls: Read each archive record and choose the supported C fact.
win_condition: All researched archive facts are correctly identified.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful execution checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Pseudocode Bridge' (Week 9 slot 11), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Camel Trail'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

source_player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the caravan wagon by solving code steps involving bridge that move the oasis keeper forward.
source_win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.75).
source_lose_condition: The rival reaches the caravan wagon first, or lives reach 0.
hint: Coordinates begin at the top left. Walls block movement. Use int declarations, observe(value), movement calls, and { } for local scope.
